text: `sudo systemctl status webapp` shows it active and running, and `cat /etc/systemd/system/webapp.service` clearly says `Environment=LISTEN_PORT=8080`. Yet `curl --max-time 5 http://localhost:8080/` times out. If the base unit file looks completely right, something else in systemd's config is winning.

systemd merges a unit file with any drop-ins under `<unit>.d/*.conf` at load time -- `cat`-ing the base `.service` file alone won't show you those. Use `sudo systemctl cat webapp.service` to see the fully merged configuration, or check the effective value directly: `sudo systemctl show webapp -p Environment`.

There's a leftover debug override at `/etc/systemd/system/webapp.service.d/override.conf` setting `LISTEN_PORT=9099`. A later `Environment=` directive for the same key wins over an earlier one, so this drop-in silently shadows the base unit's 8080 -- with zero errors from systemd. Confirm: `sudo ss -tlnp | grep 9099` should show webapp's real PID bound there instead of 8080.

Remove the stale override (or fix its value to match the documented port): `sudo rm /etc/systemd/system/webapp.service.d/override.conf`, then `sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart webapp`. Confirm with `curl http://localhost:8080/`.
